notes_for_editor: Only one history page (Idaho Fire Lookouts) describes the site; it is brief. Heights differ: the Idaho page gives 3366 ft, the trail write-up gives 3,359 ft as the high point, and both are cited in the story. The Idaho page tags it Drive Up while the loop is a hike; confirm the trailhead and whether any drive-up route exists before relying on visit.drive_up. Access rests on the state park page and a trail blog; the park update about trail closures is from the 2026 season and should be rechecked. Research used 3 WebSearch calls, one more than the per-tower budget of 2.
